content:
The \rowcolor command allows you to color the background of a row in a table in LaTeX. 

Here is an example of how to use \rowcolor in a table:

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\begin{tabular}{|c|c|c|}
\hline
\rowcolor{gray!30}
Header1 & Header2 & Header3 \\
\hline
Row1 & Value1 & Value2 \\
\hline
Row2 & Value3 & Value4 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\caption{An example table with colored row}
\end{table}

In this example, the \rowcolor{gray!30} command colors the background of the first row in a light gray shade. You can customize the color and shading by adjusting the parameters within the \rowcolor command.
